title: Material PBR Metallic Roughness
description: A set of parameter values that are used to define the metallic-roughness material model from Physically-Based Rendering (PBR) methodology.

baseColorFactor.description: The linear factors for the base color of the material.

baseColorTexture.title: Base Color Texture
baseColorTexture.description: The base color texture binding object.

metallicFactor.description: The linear factor for the metalness of the material.

roughnessFactor.description: The linear factor for the roughness of the material.
